# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old in Volume 1, reaching around 15 or 16 by Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P41](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0041)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely attractive young girl with rosy cheeks, dark hair, and soulful black eyes. She is slightly shorter and noticeably plumper than her friend Nell Harcourt, a build that occasionally causes her to wish she were more slender. She possesses a cheerful demeanor and dark eyes inherited from her mother.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, open, and prone to frequent laughter. While she is practical and pragmatic compared to her imaginative friend Nell, she enthusiastically engages in dramatic games, swearing vows of eternal friendship, and creating playhouses. She is loyal and affectionate, though occasionally defensive about school etiquette and propriety.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)_

- Cheerful and open-hearted  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

- Maintain an eternal bosom friendship with Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

## History

Isolde grows up at Pear Hill in Brierley. After returning from a visit to her aunt in Delford, she meets Nell Harcourt and the two instantly swear a solemn oath over an imaginary stream of running water to be bosom friends for life. They spend their days playing together at 'Larkrise' in the birch grove, naming local landmarks, and sharing books and stories. Isolde attends the Brierley school alongside Nell, excelling in subjects like geometry. After accidentally consuming Thirza's currant wine and becoming intoxicated, her strict mother temporarily forbids her from playing with Nell, leading to a dramatic farewell between the two girls before the misunderstanding is resolved. Later, during a sleepover at Pear Hill, Isolde and Nell accidentally jump onto the bed occupied by her visiting great-aunt Lavinia, though the incident ultimately ends in amusement and reconciliation.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P63](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0063), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087)_

## Background by volume

- Named by a schoolmaster who was lodging at Pear Hill when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Visited her aunt at Delford during her childhood  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- Accidentally became intoxicated after drinking Thirza's currant wine thinking it was raspberry cordial  <sub>[v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P44](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0044)</sub>

## Quotes

> Well, I suppose that’s true. I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> I solemnly swear to remain loyal to my bosom friend, Isolde Pembroke, for as long as the sun and moon endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> No; and oh, Nell, she tells me I must not ever play with you anymore. I have wept and wept and I explained to her that you were not to blame, but it did not help.  <sub>[v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003)</sub>

> Most certainly I shall, and no other intimate friend will ever be mine—it is not my desire to possess one. Loving anyone else as deeply as I love you is impossible for me.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
